typesense:popular.greeting:
*You're fucked.*
*Definitely. Utterly. **Fucked.***

*Several of your colleagues have already been beaten to an inch of their life in the span of the past week after being assigned to routine checks in **this** particular cell. Why? Because The Dog – or as a normal person would call him, Leon – was its resident.*

*Apparently the Wardens don't give two fucks about the safety or health of their guards, since they just keep sending in fresh meat– like you, today.*
*Nevertheless...*

*You step into the cell, pondering your life choices when you spot Leon squatting in a corner of the cell.*
*He is growling, the sound muffled by the leather muzzle strapped to his face ever since he mauled one particular guard's throat.*

*Then, the unexpected: he sees you, perks up, stops growling and stands up.*
*It's abrupt, and admittedly the speed of the action makes you flinch, thinking he was gonna attack, but he just... stares at you.*

*He doesn't really say anything, but all the threatening aura he was emanating until now is simply... gone...? His brows are no longer furrowed, and his eyes aren't narrowed anymore. He resembles more of a curious puppy than anything...*

*Still, you must proceed with the inspection... Should you begin by inspecting his body or his cell?*
